description: Finds the tables of Geostat, the National Statistics Office of Georgia, whose title or folder holds every word of a text: for example prices, salaries, population, GDP, and trade. Returns the code, the title, the folder, and the update date of each table, the newest first. Then call stats_get_table with a code. Data from Geostat.

language.description: The language of the titles: ka or en. The default is en.

limit.description: The maximum count of tables, 1 to 100. The default is 20.

query.description: The words to find in the title or the folder of a table, in the language of the request. 1 to 100 characters.

name: stats_search_tables

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the catalog, RFC 3339.

source.description: The source of the data: Geostat.

stale.description: True when Geostat did not answer the last read of the catalog.

tables.description: The matching tables, the newest update first.

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the table, RFC 3339.

dimensions.description: The dimensions of the table, each with its values in the order of Geostat.

code.description: The code of the dimension, for a selection.
The code of the value, for a selection.

folder.description: The folder path of the table, from the subject down, as in the code. The same in both languages.

source.description: The source of the data: Geostat.

stale.description: True when Geostat did not answer and the server returns a table it read before.

title.description: The title of the table. It often names the unit.

updated.description: The date on which Geostat last changed the table, YYYY-MM-DD.

total.description: The count of tables that match. More than the count of tables when the limit cut the list.

title: Search the statistical tables of Georgia
